audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree on five of seven rows: full reads Fizz/Fizz/Skill/Skill/Fizz/Skill/Skill, content and packet read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Fizz/Ekko.
audit.why: Content matches the packet levelChart and the kit. Levels 1-2 are genuinely even — Ekko Q is 1075 range against a 550-range Q dash. Level 6 is Ekko's because Chronobreak (110s) answers the dive; the first-item stage is Fizz's because a landed Chum the Waters guarantees the combo.
audit.corrected: Full rows aligned to content: rows 0-3 Skill, row 4 Ekko, row 5 Fizz, row 6 Ekko, whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why described Ekko's spike while phases[4].side said Fizz, and phases[5].why described Ekko's item spike while the content layer gives that stage to Fizz.
audit.why: Row and sentence argued opposite verdicts on two of the three stages that decide the lane.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now states the 110s Chronobreak beating the dive; first item now states Fizz's 120s Chum the Waters plus core item as his window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Playful / Trickster 'dodges your whole combo' but never that it also GROUNDS — it switches off Ekko's E, his only escape at 325 range. Chum the Waters grounds as well.
audit.why: Both are in Riot's derived flags for Fizz (E: untargetable + grounding; R: grounding + knockup), and all three missingInteractions entries point at them.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, tradeBad, enemyWin and breakdown.trading now state untargetable-plus-grounded and the 7s Seastone Trident auto reset as the wind-up tell.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Playful / Trickster 16s-8s, Seastone Trident 7s, Chum the Waters 120s, Chronobreak 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string, both under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: Title promised one thing, body explained another.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles — the 120s ultimate for the R-holding bullet, his flat damage reduction and unit-walking passive for the even-HP bullet.

edits.before: Fizz
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Q the wave and his toes — the return pass chunks; learn the slow zone's drag on his dodge patterns.
edits.after: Q both passes at 1075 range and step off — his Q dash is 550, so he cannot answer without walking in.

edits.before: Fizz
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: E blink-strike window opens: Q-E-auto is your first real trade and the third passive hit stings already.
edits.after: E opens the blink-strike, but Seastone Trident is a 7s auto reset — trade in bursts, not in exchanges.

edits.before: W zone games begin: drop it on his retreat line BEFORE trading and the stun finds him mid-regret.
edits.after: Drop W on his approach line before you trade — Playful is 16s at rank 1, so time the anomaly to its end.

edits.before: Three-hit trades on cooldown — Q in, E the gap, passive proc, walk. Bank the tempo for 6.
edits.after: Q in, E the gap, passive proc, walk — never spend the whole string into a live Playful hop.

edits.before: Fizz
edits.after: Ekko

edits.before: Chronobreak online — your aggression gets a save file. Trade like the rewind exists, because it does.
edits.after: Chronobreak at 110s beats his dive — let him commit, then rewind the exchange and walk back in.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Fizz

edits.before: First item spike: the full string deletes half bars and the rewind erases the counter-argument.
edits.after: His first core item plus a landed Chum the Waters is a combo you do not get to walk out of.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ekko

edits.before: Late Ekko picks and survives: dive the carry, W the peel, and Chronobreak out of whatever they answered with.
edits.after: Late you flank and rewind, while his 120s ultimate has to land clean or he has spent his only engage.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. It governs your forward steps. - R Chronobreak spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Playful / Trickster is 16s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5 — it goes untargetable AND grounds, so it eats your burst and switches off your E. Wait the hop out, never spend into it. - Seastone Trident is a 7s auto reset. - Chum the Waters is 120s; your Chronobreak is 110s.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, then leave early — his hop is 16s at rank 1 and cannot cover the whole trade.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: Spending the string into a live Playful / Trickster — he is untargetable through it and you are grounded after.

edits.before: Good trade: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit. Bad trade: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: Good trade: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, then leave early — his hop is 16s at rank 1 and cannot cover the trade. Bad trade: spending the whole string into a live Playful / Trickster — he is untargetable through it, and you are grounded when he lands.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Fizz wins by hopping untargetable through your burst, grounding your E out of the exchange, and landing Chum the Waters.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry by fighting after the hop — with Playful spent he has no untargetable window and nothing to ground your E.

edits.before: The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: The hop is untargetable and it grounds you — it eats the burst and cancels your E, so bait it out before you spend anything.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Chum the Waters is 120s and grounds you where it lands — hold Chronobreak for that, not for chip he can hop away from.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: His passive shaves flat damage off every source and lets him walk through minions — even HP in his wave is not even.

notes: Content win[] already matched the packet levelChart, so the side edits bring only the full layer into line and no paired win[N] edit exists to propose. No report[] entries were rewritten: none were lint-flagged and none named a fabricated ability, so the interaction fixes went into breakdown.cooldowns and the dosFull bullets instead. packet.suspectNames flags 'Land Chum the Waters' in wants.foe[0] — correct Riot name, FALSE POSITIVE. Whether Ekko's W anomaly stun can catch Fizz during the untargetable portion of Playful / Trickster is not answerable from Riot's text, so phases[2].why times the anomaly to the end of the hop rather than claiming it connects through it.
